name: TaskStop
description: Stop a running background task in the execution registry — a backgrounded sub-agent (Agent tool dispatch), shell, or workflow. Pass the task id returned from the Agent tool result. Aborts the in-flight controller and marks the task as killed, returning a success or failure status. An id that is not a running registry task is reported as a failure (not found).

task_id.description: The id of the task to cancel.
